ops.title: yasyf box synckit root cause FINAL: mise-path dev synckitd shadows brew 0.35.2; repair order changed
ops.body:
`which -a synckitd` on the yasyf box: `~/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.26.5/bin/synckitd` (FIRST on PATH — a `go install` dev build dated Jul 24 22:17, the swarm's final night, self-reporting `9999.1784956626035025182.0-dev`) shadows `/opt/homebrew/bin/synckitd` (brew 0.35.2). One fact explains the whole failure surface: the dev daemon demands the v1 state envelope (Jul 3 state.json predates it), strict-rejects `watch.backend` in manifests, and spawns `<binary> sync rpc-serve` — a subcommand NEITHER installed peer has (verified: cc-pool sync has only disable/enable/status; reposync sync has no subcommands). The daemon is from the future; its peers are from the present.

**Repair order for the yasyf box (changes step 1)**:
1. Remove the shadowing dev build (delete the mise-installed synckitd, or reorder PATH) so brew's binary resolves — "brew upgrade synckitd" alone would silently change nothing. (A future window should confirm what installed it: mise shim vs bare `go install` with GOBIN in mise dir.)
2. Then converge normally per A4/A5: install baseline-pinned synckit/reposync/cc-pool releases (whose daemon+peers+manifest schema agree), regenerate mesh state via `synckitd host add` (the daemon's own prescribed migration — preserves peer yasyf@yasyf-home), restart serve/reconcile/cookiesync.
3. Local machine checked: NO equivalent shadowing (only brew synckitd on PATH, no fleet binaries in mise go bins).

Also: WoL does NOT wake this box (randomized private Wi-Fi MAC, 150+ packets ignored); windows are natural flaps roughly half-hourly. And its HTTPS push auth is dead non-interactively — automation must use SSH remotes (papercut recorded).
